changelog: Fixes the explosion animation. In 0.0.69 the burst slid sideways across the tile like a strip of paper instead of cutting cleanly from frame to frame -- each step was landing halfway between two frames and showing half of each. It now steps exactly on frame boundaries. Everything from 0.0.69 is included: explosions on every tile a blast catches, the boss dialogue overhaul (an opening line, wound reactions, and losses they notice), the new Warlord card frame, and card-to-card navigation in the zoomed view.
